children.text: Here is a photo of my family.
children.notes: Here is... 句型用于介绍眼前的事物。
children.statement: “Here is...” 用于引出单数名词或代词。
children.explanation: 题干已给出开头，此句顺承其意。

children.text: My grandpa Ben and my grandma Sarah are old, healthy and very kind to us.
children.cn: 我的爷爷本和奶奶萨拉年纪大了，身体健康，对我们非常慈祥。
children.notes: be kind to sb.: 对某人友善/慈祥
children.statement: “kind” 在句中作表语，意为“慈祥的”。
children.explanation: 使用了表格中的参考词汇 kind。

children.text: My father Mike is a tall doctor, and my mother Amy is a beautiful woman.
children.cn: 我的爸爸迈克是一位高大的医生，我的妈妈埃米是一位美丽的女士。
children.explanation: 使用了表格中的参考词汇 beautiful。

children.text: I also have a lovely sister named Cindy and a cute brother named Bob.
children.cn: 我还有一个叫辛迪的可爱妹妹和一个叫鲍勃的可爱弟弟。
children.statement: “named” 过去分词作后置定语修饰 sister 和 brother。
children.explanation: 涵盖了表格中所有剩余的家庭成员信息。

children.text: We all love sports, so we often play tennis together on sunny weekends.
children.cn: 我们都热爱运动，所以我们经常在晴朗的周末一起打网球。
children.notes: play tennis: 打网球; on weekends: 在周末
children.explanation: 使用了参考词汇 tennis 和 sports。
children.keywords: love sports, play tennis, together, weekends

children.text: I love every member of my family and we live happily together.
children.cn: 我爱我家的每一个成员，我们快乐地生活在一起。
children.notes: every member: 每个成员; happily: 快乐地（副词修饰动词 live）
children.explanation: 总结家庭温馨美好的氛围。

children.text: Here is a photo of my family.
children.notes: 开门见山引出全家福照片。

children.text: My grandpa Ben and my grandma Sarah are both kind, wise and energetic.
children.cn: 我的爷爷本和奶奶萨拉既慈祥又睿智，且充满活力。
children.notes: both... and...: 既……又……; energetic: 精力充沛的
children.explanation: 运用多个精准形容词提升表达丰富度。

children.text: My father Mike enjoys playing tennis, while my mother Amy is a beautiful and patient teacher.
children.cn: 我的爸爸迈克喜欢打网球，而我的妈妈埃米是一位漂亮且有耐心的老师。
children.notes: enjoy doing: 喜欢做某事; while: 然而，而（对比连词）
children.explanation: 巧妙结合了 tennis 与 beautiful 参考词汇。
children.keywords: enjoys playing tennis, while, beautiful, patient teacher

children.text: In addition, I have a cute younger sister Cindy and a lively little brother Bob.
children.cn: 此外，我还有一个可爱的妹妹辛迪和一个活泼的小弟弟鲍勃。
children.notes: In addition: 此外; lively: 活泼的
children.statement: “In addition” 作为过渡词连接段落。
children.explanation: 衔接词使语篇更加自然流畅。
children.keywords: In addition, sister Cindy, lively brother Bob

children.text: All of us share a passion for sports and spend quality time together every weekend.
children.cn: 我们大家都热爱体育运动，每个周末都共度美好时光。
children.notes: share a passion for: 热爱……; spend quality time: 度过美好时光
children.statement: “quality time” 意为“有意义的美好时光”。
children.explanation: 展示高级词汇搭配与温馨家庭生活。
children.keywords: passion for sports, quality time, weekend

children.text: We always support each other because family is the warmest harbor in our lives.
children.cn: 我们总是互相支持，因为家庭是我们生命中最温暖的港湾。
children.notes: support each other: 互相支持; harbor: 港湾
children.statement: “because” 引导原因状语从句升华主题。
children.explanation: 以比喻修辞深化文章主题，富有感染力。
children.keywords: support each other, because, warmest harbor
